observations: Electronic keyboard wrapped in clear plastic film.
The brand 'YAMAHA' is visible on the center of the body in photo 0.
The control panel is silver or light grey with a small central LCD screen.
A power cable is visible on the left side.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'NIFTY MUSICALS' are present on the image.

claims.evidence: The full keyboard is not clearly countable and key size cannot be verified from this angle.
Button labels are unreadable due to the plastic wrap and image resolution.
The text on the control panel is too blurry to confirm this feature.
The song list printed on the panel and the screen content are unreadable.

risks.proof: A video of every key being played and major function buttons being pressed.

risks.risk: LCD screen failure (bleeding or dead pixels)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the screen powered on.

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos of the unit with the plastic wrap removed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the model name/number, usually found on the right side of the control panel or the rear identification plate.
Photo of the keyboard powered on showing the LCD screen.
Video of a scale being played across all keys to confirm they all trigger sound.
Photo of the included power adapter.
response.reason: The specific model number is unreadable due to the plastic wrap and the angle of the photo. Yamaha keyboards vary greatly in value based on the specific model series.
